name: gross9_fixed_candidate_and_state_substitution_battery
objective: Find a fixed, executable alpha sleeve that improves the exact Gross9 portfolio rather than merely increasing leverage or re-tuning a gate.

nonpb30_taker.mechanism: positive taker imbalance during a volatile standardized pullback with a wide four-hour range

oi_divergence_highfreq.mechanism: short-horizon continuation after OI absorbs a volatile price pullback while price remains below SMA24

state_contract.top_n_order: use each persisted pre-evaluation ordering only

explicit_exclusions.oi_divergence_pullback: already rejected by G9-OIDP-1 pre-2025 marginal audit
explicit_exclusions.oi_upbit_ratio288_low: already present in the authoritative Gross9 allocation universe and selected at zero
explicit_exclusions.funding_premium_lr_impact_central: already present in the authoritative Gross9 allocation universe and selected at zero
explicit_exclusions.oi_alt_ratio72_dynamic_exit: live alt-volume feature and research/live exit parity are incomplete
explicit_exclusions.pb30_modules: overlap the existing long pullback/funding family and have weak 2026 risk without a clean marginal contract
explicit_exclusions.exact_state_model_representatives: would permit post-evaluation representative picking; only frozen Top-10 majority is allowed

execution_contract.funding_for_fixed_hold: excluded for parity with frozen Gross9 research accounting

selection_contract.addition_rule: keep all Gross9 weights and add candidate weight; gross becomes 9+weight; compare to pro-rata Gross9 at identical gross
selection_contract.state_substitution_rule: replace x of markov_transition_long 2.0 with x of exactly one state candidate; keep funding_premium family gross and total gross fixed at 2.0 and 9.0
requirements: train strict MDD <=40% and test2024 strict MDD <=20%
train and test2024 absolute returns each remain positive and >=97% of Gross9 baseline
candidate standalone train and test2024 absolute returns are positive
candidate portfolio beats its comparator CAGR/strict-MDD in both train and test2024
minimum train/test2024 ratio improvement over comparator is >=0.05
at least one selection window strict MDD is lower than Gross9 baseline
entry Jaccard versus every non-replaced Gross9 sleeve is <=0.50
all exact entry counts equal event counts

comparator.addition_family_cap_treatment: same-gross pro-rata control is a non-deployable diagnostic leverage counterfactual and is explicitly exempt from family caps; the candidate portfolio itself must satisfy every family cap

selection_contract.rank: maximize minimum train/test2024 ratio improvement over comparator, then geometric mean improvement, then test2024 MDD reduction, then test2024 absolute-return retention, then lower changed weight, then lexical candidate name

jaccard_scope.addition: candidate versus every positive-weight Gross9 sleeve, including markov_transition_long
jaccard_scope.state_substitution: candidate versus every positive-weight Gross9 sleeve except markov_transition_long; Markov shares the same base setup and is always excluded from acceptance Jaccard even when residual Markov weight remains
jaccard_scope.mandatory_state_overlap_diagnostic: report exact entry Jaccard and occupied-bar overlap against markov_transition_long for every state cell despite the acceptance exemption

requirements: eval2025 and ytd2026 portfolio absolute returns remain positive, strict MDD <=20%, and ratio >=3
neither future ratio falls by more than 0.25 versus Gross9 and at least one future ratio improves
candidate standalone eval2025 plus ytd2026 compounded return is positive
10bp/notional/side stress keeps eval2025 and ytd2026 portfolio returns positive
for addition candidates only, the fixed July candidate replay must be non-negative; state strict-majority candidates have no equivalent frozen July metric and remain forward-shadow regardless

july_scope.addition_candidates: use the already frozen July atomic replay only; negative candidate absolute return vetoes top1
july_scope.state_substitution_candidates: the frozen July artifact did not replay the 6-of-10 strict-majority sleeves, so it cannot be substituted with single-representative metrics; July is unavailable and no July pass is claimed
july_scope.state_disposition_if_other_vetoes_pass: forward shadow only until a prospective strict-majority observation window is collected

required_diagnostics: exact entry Jaccard and occupied overlap
source signal hashes and schedule counts
state candidate versus residual Markov overlap even though it is excluded from acceptance Jaccard

known_research_exposure.prior_state_portfolio_result_known: The earlier freely reoptimized state portfolio selected BOCPD pre-2025 but failed its future veto; this new test freezes Gross9 and only permits within-family substitution.
known_research_exposure.july_known: July atomic performance was inspected before this audit and is veto-only.
known_research_exposure.disposition: A survivor is forward-shadow evidence, not pristine OOS or permission for live capital.
